Markov Chain Neutron Decay Simulation

Code

neutron_chain_animation.m
MATLAB
%% Animated neutron branching Markov-chain simulation
% Neutrons travel from left to right and collide with one atom per neutron.
% At every collision, Monte Carlo sampling selects one of three outcomes:
%   blue atom   = neutron escaped       (0 children)
%   red atom    = neutron was absorbed  (0 children)
%   yellow atom = atom underwent fission (2 children)
%
% The children from fission become the active neutrons in the next
% generation. No special MATLAB toolboxes are required.

clear; clc; close all;

%% Simulation settings
initialNeutrons     = 6;
maxGenerations     = 8;
neutronsPerFission = 2;

pEscape     = 0.20;
pAbsorption = 0.25;
pFission    = 0.55;

framesPerFlight   = 28;      % Increase for smoother/slower motion
framePause        = 0.008;   % Faster motion while retaining smooth frames
collisionPause    = 0.10;    % Briefly display each generation's outcomes
escapeFrames      = framesPerFlight; % Smooth scattered-neutron flight
escapeForwardDistance = 3.50; % Cross several atom layers before vanishing
escapeDeflection      = 0.35; % Still a shallow forward-scattering angle
maxVisualNeutrons = 120;     % Prevent an overcrowded/slow figure

% Use rng(7) instead if you want the exact same animation every run.
rng("shuffle");

%% Validate probabilities
if any([pEscape pAbsorption pFission] < 0) || ...
        abs(pEscape + pAbsorption + pFission - 1) > 1e-12
    error('Probabilities must be nonnegative and add up to 1.');
end

%% Colors
backgroundColor = [0.035 0.045 0.070];
neutronColor    = [0.15 0.90 1.00];
unusedAtomColor = [0.55 0.58 0.65];
escapeColor     = [0.20 0.55 1.00];
absorbColor     = [1.00 0.28 0.18];
fissionColor    = [1.00 0.82 0.15];
pathColor       = [0.12 0.25 0.34];

%% Create the animation window
fig = figure('Color', backgroundColor, ...
    'Name', 'Animated Neutron Chain Reaction', ...
    'NumberTitle', 'off');
ax = axes(fig);
hold(ax, 'on');
ax.Color = backgroundColor;
ax.XColor = [0.85 0.88 0.95];
ax.YColor = [0.85 0.88 0.95];
ax.GridColor = [0.30 0.34 0.42];
ax.GridAlpha = 0.35;
grid(ax, 'on');
xlim(ax, [-0.4 maxGenerations + 3.75]);
ylim(ax, [-1.12 1.12]);
xticks(ax, 0:maxGenerations);
yticks(ax, []);
xlabel(ax, 'Generation / atom layer');
title(ax, 'Neutrons move right and undergo a random outcome at each atom', ...
    'Color', [0.94 0.96 1.00]);

% Dummy points create an explanatory legend.
hNeutron = scatter(ax, nan, nan, 34, neutronColor, 'filled');
hUnused  = scatter(ax, nan, nan, 70, unusedAtomColor, 'filled');
hEscape  = scatter(ax, nan, nan, 70, escapeColor, 'filled');
hAbsorb  = scatter(ax, nan, nan, 70, absorbColor, 'filled');
hFission = scatter(ax, nan, nan, 70, fissionColor, 'filled');
lgd = legend(ax, [hNeutron hUnused hEscape hAbsorb hFission], ...
    {'Neutron','Unhit atom','Escaped','Absorbed','Fission'}, ...
    'TextColor', [0.92 0.94 1.00], 'Color', backgroundColor, ...
    'Location', 'southoutside', 'Orientation', 'horizontal');
lgd.AutoUpdate = 'off';

%% Initial neutron positions at generation 0
activeY = linspace(-0.72, 0.72, initialNeutrons).';
activeX = 0;
activeMarker = scatter(ax, activeX * ones(size(activeY)), activeY, ...
    34, neutronColor, 'filled', 'MarkerEdgeColor', [0.85 1.00 1.00]);

% Arrays record the numerical result while the animation runs.
population = zeros(maxGenerations + 1, 1);
population(1) = initialNeutrons;
escapedCount = zeros(maxGenerations, 1);
absorbedCount = zeros(maxGenerations, 1);
fissionCount = zeros(maxGenerations, 1);
completedGenerations = 0;

% Escaped particles from one collision remain pending until the next flight.
% They will leave the screen while the fission children move toward the
% next atom layer, so every moving neutron is animated at the same time.
pendingEscapeMarker = [];
pendingEscapeY0 = [];
pendingEscapeX0 = 0;

statusText = text(ax, 0, 1.02, ...
    sprintf('Initial population: %d neutrons', initialNeutrons), ...
    'Color', [0.94 0.96 1.00], 'FontWeight', 'bold', ...
    'HorizontalAlignment', 'left');
drawnow;
pause(0.7);

%% Animate one generation at a time
for generation = 1:maxGenerations
    currentNeutrons = numel(activeY);

    if currentNeutrons == 0
        set(statusText, 'String', sprintf( ...
            'Generation %d: chain reaction died out', generation - 1), ...
            'Position', [max(0, generation - 1) 1.02 0], ...
            'Color', absorbColor);
        break;
    end

    if currentNeutrons > maxVisualNeutrons
        set(statusText, 'String', sprintf( ...
            'Stopped: %d active neutrons exceed visual limit of %d', ...
            currentNeutrons, maxVisualNeutrons), ...
            'Position', [max(0, generation - 1) 1.02 0], ...
            'Color', fissionColor);
        break;
    end

    atomX = generation;

    % Spread the target atoms vertically across the next layer. Sorting the
    % incoming locations reduces excessive crossing of flight paths.
    activeY = sort(activeY);
    targetY = linspace(-0.88, 0.88, currentNeutrons).';

    atomMarker = scatter(ax, atomX * ones(currentNeutrons, 1), targetY, ...
        82, unusedAtomColor, 'filled', ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor', [0.82 0.84 0.90], 'LineWidth', 0.7);

    % Leave faint trajectory lines behind so the branching structure can
    % still be seen after the neutrons move.
    % NaN separators let one Line object draw every trajectory. Creating a
    % separate graphics object for every neutron becomes slow as the chain
    % grows, so this keeps later generations responsive.
    pathX = reshape([activeX * ones(currentNeutrons, 1), ...
                     atomX * ones(currentNeutrons, 1), ...
                     nan(currentNeutrons, 1)].', [], 1);
    pathY = reshape([activeY, targetY, ...
                     nan(currentNeutrons, 1)].', [], 1);
    plot(ax, pathX, pathY, '-', 'Color', pathColor, 'LineWidth', 0.55);

    set(statusText, 'String', sprintf( ...
        'Generation %d: %d neutrons flying toward %d atoms', ...
        generation, currentNeutrons, currentNeutrons), ...
        'Position', [generation - 1 1.02 0], ...
        'Color', [0.94 0.96 1.00]);

    % Animate all active neutrons flying to their target atoms. At the same
    % time, escaped neutrons from the previous layer scatter forward past
    % this atom layer without interacting with it.
    if ~isempty(pendingEscapeY0)
        pendingEscapeDirection = sign(pendingEscapeY0);
        pendingEscapeDirection(pendingEscapeDirection == 0) = 1;
        pendingEscapeXEnd = pendingEscapeX0 + escapeForwardDistance;
        pendingEscapeYEnd = pendingEscapeY0 + ...
            escapeDeflection * pendingEscapeDirection;
    end

    for frame = 1:framesPerFlight
        fraction = frame / framesPerFlight;
        % Smoothstep makes the motion accelerate and decelerate gently.
        smoothFraction = fraction^2 * (3 - 2*fraction);
        movingX = activeX + (atomX - activeX) * smoothFraction;
        movingY = activeY + (targetY - activeY) * smoothFraction;
        set(activeMarker, 'XData', movingX * ones(currentNeutrons, 1), ...
            'YData', movingY);

        if ~isempty(pendingEscapeY0)
            escapeFraction = min(frame / escapeFrames, 1);
            smoothEscape = escapeFraction^2 * (3 - 2*escapeFraction);
            set(pendingEscapeMarker, ...
                'XData', (pendingEscapeX0 + smoothEscape * ...
                    (pendingEscapeXEnd - pendingEscapeX0)) * ...
                    ones(size(pendingEscapeY0)), ...
                'YData', pendingEscapeY0 + smoothEscape.* ...
                    (pendingEscapeYEnd - pendingEscapeY0));
        end

        drawnow;
        pause(framePause);
    end

    if ~isempty(pendingEscapeY0)
        set(pendingEscapeMarker, ...
            'XData', nan(size(pendingEscapeY0)), ...
            'YData', nan(size(pendingEscapeY0)));
        pendingEscapeY0 = [];
    end

    %% Monte Carlo decision at each collision
    randomNumbers = rand(currentNeutrons, 1);
    escaped = randomNumbers < pEscape;
    absorbed = randomNumbers >= pEscape & ...
        randomNumbers < pEscape + pAbsorption;
    fissioned = randomNumbers >= pEscape + pAbsorption;

    escapedCount(generation) = sum(escaped);
    absorbedCount(generation) = sum(absorbed);
    fissionCount(generation) = sum(fissioned);

    % Recolor every struck atom to show which outcome occurred.
    outcomeColors = zeros(currentNeutrons, 3);
    outcomeColors(escaped, :) = repmat(escapeColor, sum(escaped), 1);
    outcomeColors(absorbed, :) = repmat(absorbColor, sum(absorbed), 1);
    outcomeColors(fissioned, :) = repmat(fissionColor, sum(fissioned), 1);
    set(atomMarker, 'CData', outcomeColors);

    nextNeutrons = neutronsPerFission * sum(fissioned);
    population(generation + 1) = nextNeutrons;
    completedGenerations = generation;

    set(statusText, 'String', sprintf( ...
        ['Generation %d outcomes:  escaped %d   absorbed %d   ' ...
         'fission %d  ->  %d new neutrons'], ...
        generation, sum(escaped), sum(absorbed), sum(fissioned), ...
        nextNeutrons), ...
        'Position', [generation - 1 1.02 0]);
    drawnow;
    pause(collisionPause);

    %% Prepare every particle to leave the collision together
    % Reuse the incoming-neutron graphics object for the escaped particles.
    % These will fly offscreen during the same frames in which the fission
    % children travel toward the next atom layer.
    pendingEscapeY0 = targetY(escaped);
    pendingEscapeX0 = atomX;
    pendingEscapeMarker = activeMarker;
    set(pendingEscapeMarker, ...
        'XData', atomX * ones(size(pendingEscapeY0)), ...
        'YData', pendingEscapeY0, ...
        'Clipping', 'on');

    % Each fission creates two children, initially separated slightly above
    % and below the struck atom.
    fissionY = targetY(fissioned);
    separation = 0.035;
    childY = reshape([fissionY - separation, ...
                      fissionY + separation].', [], 1);
    childY = max(-0.96, min(0.96, childY));
    activeMarker = scatter(ax, atomX * ones(size(childY)), childY, ...
        34, neutronColor, 'filled', ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor', [0.85 1.00 1.00]);

    % The fission children are the current state used next time through the
    % loop. Absorbed and escaped neutrons are not propagated.
    activeY = childY;
    activeX = atomX;
end

%% Let any escaped particles from the final generation finish leaving
% Usually this motion occurs concurrently with the next generation. There
% is no next flight after the last generation or after extinction, so only
% the remaining escaped particles need to be finished here.
if ~isempty(pendingEscapeY0)
    pendingEscapeDirection = sign(pendingEscapeY0);
    pendingEscapeDirection(pendingEscapeDirection == 0) = 1;
    pendingEscapeXEnd = pendingEscapeX0 + escapeForwardDistance;
    pendingEscapeYEnd = pendingEscapeY0 + ...
        escapeDeflection * pendingEscapeDirection;

    for frame = 1:escapeFrames
        fraction = frame / escapeFrames;
        smoothFraction = fraction^2 * (3 - 2*fraction);
        set(pendingEscapeMarker, ...
            'XData', (pendingEscapeX0 + smoothFraction * ...
                (pendingEscapeXEnd - pendingEscapeX0)) * ...
                ones(size(pendingEscapeY0)), ...
            'YData', pendingEscapeY0 + smoothFraction.* ...
                (pendingEscapeYEnd - pendingEscapeY0));
        drawnow;
        pause(framePause);
    end

    set(pendingEscapeMarker, ...
        'XData', nan(size(pendingEscapeY0)), ...
        'YData', nan(size(pendingEscapeY0)));
end

%% Print the numerical record after the animation
if completedGenerations > 0
    generationNumber = (1:completedGenerations).';
    startPopulation = population(1:completedGenerations);
    nextPopulation = population(2:completedGenerations + 1);

    results = table(generationNumber, startPopulation, ...
        escapedCount(1:completedGenerations), ...
        absorbedCount(1:completedGenerations), ...
        fissionCount(1:completedGenerations), nextPopulation, ...
        'VariableNames', {'Generation','StartNeutrons','Escaped', ...
        'Absorbed','Fissions','NextNeutrons'});
    disp(results);
end

kExpected = neutronsPerFission * pFission;
fprintf('\nExpected multiplication factor k = %.2f\n', kExpected);
fprintf('The exact animation changes each run because rng("shuffle") is used.\n');
